layout_sources: https://github.com/firefly-iii/import-configurations/blob/main/nl/ing/default.json (2024: semicolon, header row, date Ymd, 11 columns: date, name, own IBAN, counter IBAN, code, ing-debit-credit, amount, mutatiesoort, note, saldo, tag)

https://github.com/gpaulissen/ofxstatement-dutch/blob/master/src/ofxstatement/plugins/nl/ing.py (header words, Af/Bij sign column, MutatieSoort renamed Mutatiesoort; the newer semicolon export adds columns)
https://github.com/bank2ynab/bank2ynab/blob/master/bank2ynab.conf [NL ING Checking 2020] (file name NL..INGB.._dd-mm-yyyy_dd-mm-yyyy.csv, %Y%m%d, Af/Bij indicator)
https://support.yuki.nl/en/support/solutions/articles/80000787467-ing-bank-export-files (columns incl. Saldo na mutatie and Tag)
notes: Mijn ING "Af- en bijschrijvingen downloaden", semicolon-separated variant: every field double-quoted, dates YYYYMMDD, amount always positive with a comma decimal and no thousands mark, the sign only in the "Af Bij" column (Af = money out, Bij = money in), "Saldo na mutatie" is the balance after each line, "Tag" empty. Newest first. Encoding not confirmed (content kept ASCII); CRLF line ends assumed. Opening worked back from the oldest line (370,35 + 1150,00); closing is the newest line's balance.
